warning.titlePre: Land Rover Freelander TD4 Timing Chain & Injector Wear
paragraphs: If your Freelander TD4 has the BMW M47D20 diesel engine — fitted to the L359 generation from 2006 to 2014 — timing chain stretch and injector seal leaks are a well-documented pattern on this engine, shared with BMW 3 and 5 Series models of the same era. We replace the timing chain, bearings and gaskets as standard on every M47D20 rebuild.

Other Freelander variants use different engines — the 1.8i has the Rover K-Series petrol, the 2.5 V6 is a different petrol unit, and the eD4/SD4 use Ford Duratorq diesels — so this specific issue only affects the TD4 with the BMW M47D20.
warning.source: Source: BMW M47 pattern, shared with BMW 3/5 Series of same era, per VRF-landrover-freelander.md. Only the M47D20-fitted TD4 is affected by this specific pattern
